page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text, top to bottom. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. No marginal notes, no footnotes. The lower part of the page is blank apart from show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: quam ante Latinè confictam ediderat?annon ha-bere ad manum Græculum eundem tribus obolis conductū interpretem potuit, cuius opera in fig-mento Donationis Constantini Græcè vertendo usus antea fuerat?qua ex officina superioris quoq; legis septimæ partem eam prodiisse non dubito, in qua tantopere Papæ R. auctoritas prædicatur: cùm ea prædicatio,tum à Iustiniani consuetudine (quod antea demonstrauimus)tum ab orientalium Episcoporum & Ecclesiarum instituto nimium quantum abhorreat.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side (faint text in the lower two-thirds of the page) is not transcribed. The word "conducto" is read as "conductū" with a macron; the macron is faint on the scan. The question marks after "ediderat" and "fuerat" are printed as shown.
